cases.requirement: The well-known discovery document is readable without credentials and advertises protocol 0.1 plus every capability required by this profile.
A protected operation without a bearer token returns HTTP 401 and discloses no memory content.
An authenticated connection lacking memory:proposal:write receives HTTP 403 when proposing memory.
An authorized evidence-bearing proposal receives a canonical opaque memory ID and positive version without becoming caller-confirmed.
Repeating the same proposal with the same idempotency key returns the same memory ID and version and creates no second record.
Context resolution returns the primary workspace proposal to its authorized connection.
A different authenticated workspace cannot discover the primary workspace memory ID or unique content through context resolution.
Deletion with an expected version that is not current returns HTTP 409 and preserves the current record.
Deletion at the exact current version returns a consecutive tombstone revision and removes the content from context results.
A sync pull returns changes only for the authenticated workspace and never includes another workspace fixture ID.
Every non-empty sync page has unique change IDs and strictly increasing positive canonical sequences.
